# Contributing

Laplace-Wiki is written by the inventor of Laplace. Every page holds only the inventor's words, so pull requests that add or rewrite page text are not accepted.

## Reporting a problem

Open an [issue](https://github.com/SaltyPatron/Laplace-Wiki/issues/new/choose) for an error, a broken link, a page that does not render, or something unclear.

## Questions and ideas

Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/SaltyPatron/Laplace-Wiki/discussions).

## Tooling

Changes to the checks, the site build, or the workflows are welcome as pull requests. Every pull request must pass the Check wiki workflow. See the Checks and Site sections of [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
